CreateAccelerator.description_en: Global Accelerator (GA) is a network acceleration service that provides coverage across the globe. It uses Alibaba Cloud's high-quality Border Gateway Protocol (BGP) bandwidth and global transmission network to provide low-latency access from nearby locations. This reduces the impact of network issues, such as latency, jitter, and packet loss, on your service quality. GA provides a high-availability and high-performance network acceleration service for users worldwide. You can call the CreateAccelerator operation to create a Global Accelerator instance
